description: HCPCS Level II billing code search (CMS code set, via NLM Clinical Tables): code and short description for procedures, supplies and drugs, with total match count. CPT codes are AMA-licensed and not included. Up to 20 codes per call. Choose this tool for: HCPCS Level II billing code search: code and short. Close alternatives on this server: health_dbSNP_polymorphisms (NCBI dbSNP short variant record by rs number: variant type); health_health_insurance_exchange (ACA Health Insurance Marketplace overview for a US ZIP code). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
